subject: MSA redlines & procurement portal setup — NovaHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Peter Holm <p.holm@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: MSA + procurement portal for Redwood

Hi Ben,

Were starting vendor setup for Redwood on NovaHealths procurement side. Procurement wants a signed MSA + order form on file before they provision Ariba access. Can you confirm: 1) whether you have an MSA we can redline, 2) if Redwood can support PO-level line items and PO number on invoices, and 3) whether you support Coupa punchout / Ariba cXML mapping (we use both across different BUs)?

Ive attached our procurement requirements workbook that shows required fields for vendor registration and our PO template. Also: our legal team will circulate their MSA redline once procurement confirms youre willing to accept a couple of commercial concessions (SLA credit cap and liability carveouts).

Attachements: NH_Procurement_Requirements_2026.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Peter Holm
Senior Sourcing Manager
NovaHealth Procurement
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Peter Holm <p.holm@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: MSA + procurement portal for Redwood

Hi Peter — thanks for the note and the workbook. Short answers up front: yes on an MSA we can share for redline, yes on including PO numbers on invoices, and we can map to Coupa/Ariba fields (weve done both with other enterprise customers). That said, a couple of clarifications so we dont lose time:

- We have a standard MSA (attached) and were happy to review NovaHealths redline. Our legal team will prioritize the sections you flagged (SLAs, liability).
- For portal mapping, procurement should confirm whether youre using cXML punchout or CSV/catalog upload for the initial catalog. If youre expecting a punchout integration well need engineering timelines.
- We typically complete vendor registration after a countersigned MSA + order form; procurement can provision vendor codes earlier for testing if needed.

Im attaching: Redwood_MSA_Clean_2026-04-19.pdf and a short Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.docx we use to speed vendor portal setup.

Proposed next steps:
1) NovaHealth legal sends redline to this thread.
2) We schedule a 30-min call (legal + procurement + engineering) to walk the redline and portal mapping (Thursday would work for us).
3) We upload a sample invoice format and a W9 for compliance.

If youd like I can loop in our integration engineer for the Coupa/Ariba details — Karthik, can you be available for a portal mapping call?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Clean_2026-04-19.pdf (PDF); Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.docx (DOCX)
From: Peter Holm <p.holm@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaHealth Procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-21T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: MSA + procurement portal for Redwood

Ben — thanks, thats helpful. Attaching our PO template for your team. A few procurement notes:

- Our buyers require a PO number on every invoice and an invoice line-item breakdown that maps to our chart of accounts.
- For Coupa we typically do a catalog CSV upload for the initial setup, switching to punchout for dynamic pricing later. If Redwood prefers punchout please provide the punchout endpoint and SSO details.
- We need a countersigned MSA + order form to move to full production; procurement can create a vendor code earlier if you provide a sample invoice and tax docs.

Ive copied our legal lead (Ruth) on this thread — she will send redlines on the contractual side.

Attachments: NH_PO_Template_v2.docx (DOCX)

Date: 2026-04-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MSA annotated for NovaHealth — proposed discussion

Hi Ruth / Peter — thanks for sending the PO template. Our legal team did a first pass and Im attaching an annotated MSA that calls out two items we expect to be discussed: indemnity limits and data handling (especially production telemetry / logs).

Key notes from our side:
- SLA credits: we are open to discussing a limited SLA credit structure but need an overall cap tied to the order form value.
- Data handling/processing: we can agree to reasonable controls and a DPA, but data residency and retention windows may need narrow language.
- Procurement mapping: Karthik, can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a sample invoice CSV and a mapping document for AR/AP?

Wed propose a 30-minute legal + procurement call Thursday 2026-04-23 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work for NovaHealth? If not, propose an alternate.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Annotated_for_NovaHealth.pdf (PDF)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Ruth Manning <ruth.manning@novahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Holm <p.holm@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: NH redline + questions on SLA and catalog integration

Laura / Ben — attached is NovaHealths redline. A couple items to highlight so we can focus on them in the call:

- SLA credit cap: our legal team pushed for a 25% of monthly fees cap for outage credits; your annotated MSA references an alternative cap tied to order form value. Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a cap in line with the order form value or the % cap?
- Catalog / Coupa: procurement needs confirmation that Redwood can support CSV catalog uploads and that invoice line items will map to our account codes (we provided the mapping sheet). If punchout is preferred, we need the integration spec.
- DocuSign: procurement requested an order form draft for signature; Ill send a DocuSign envelope for the order form once we align the two commercial points above.

Attachements: NH_MSA_Redline_2026-04-22.pdf (PDF)

Also, could you provide a W9 (or local tax form) for vendor setup?

Thanks,
Ruth Manning
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | NovaHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Peter Holm <p.holm@novahealth.com>, Ruth Manning <ruth.manning@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NH redline + questions on SLA and catalog integration — next steps

Ruth / Peter — thanks for the redline. Quick response with concrete next steps so procurement can keep moving: 

1) SLA credit cap: Legal is amenable to aligning the cap to the order form value (well propose language that sets a hard cap based on annualized order form fees). Laura will bring the suggested wording to the call.
2) Catalog / Coupa: Karthik confirms we can deliver a CSV catalog upload that maps to NovaHealths account codes; we can also support punchout, but that requires an engineering window. For initial onboarding we recommend CSV upload + test invoices.
3) Docs for vendor setup: attached Redwood_W9.pdf and an OrderForm_NH_Draft_v1.docx for your review. Well accept DocuSign for signatures.

Proposed schedule: 30-min call Thursday 2026-04-23 at 10:00 AM PT (same invite, legal + procurement + Karthik for portal mapping). If thats good, Ill send a calendar invite.
